description: 福岡市 給水スポット一覧 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 福岡市. 福岡市内の給水スポットに関する情報（給水スポット基本情報）一覧です。 「給水スポット基本情報」は、「福岡市給水スポット基本情報データモデル定義書」に基づき作成しています。 「給水スポット基本情報」の各項目については「福岡市給水スポット基本情報データモデル定義書」をご参照ください。. Coverage: 福岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 福岡市. Its tags are 位置情報, 緯度経度. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
